title: Three card spread, past present future

fields.name: question
fields.description: Optional specific question to focus the reading. Examples: "What should I know about my relationship?", "How can I improve my finances?", "What is blocking my creative growth?" Leave empty for general guidance.
fields.example: What do I need to know about my career?

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Optional seed for reproducible results. Same seed = same 3 cards in same positions. Useful for sharing readings, testing, or ensuring users get consistent results. Omit for random draws.
